pm25_value_distribution.partition_note: The four groups (NULL, <0, >500, [0,500]) partition all 71,149,372 ObservedPM25 records.
pm25_value_distribution.numerical_validity_convention_note: Data-quality convention used for numerical aggregation in JPM2KG and in the AirCypher-150 reference queries. It is a convention adopted for this graph, not an external or universal standard.

pm25_level_bands.not_an_official_classification: These five bands are the mapping implemented in JPM2KG. They are not an official WHO classification and not an official Japanese regulatory classification.
pm25_level_bands.records_without_pm25_level_note: Records whose stored pm25 is NULL (3,087,056) or negative (1,974,663) carry no pm25_level.
